remarks: West Norwalk Classic Cape. Full of charm. Situated on 1.18 Acres of tranquility. Generous size rooms, Living room with fireplace, hardwood floors throughout. Large remodeled eat-in-kitchen. Formal dining room with built-in corner hutch. 4 bedrooms,2 full baths, and two car garage. Close to Darien train and all shopping. Tenants responsible for yard care, snow removal and garbage. NO PETS!!! NO SMOKERS!!! Favorable credit, and adequate income a must! Renters insurance required.
